pkgmetadata.longdescription: Modular's closed-source MAX platform runtime and prebuilt Mojo compiler, repackaged unmodified from the official PyPI wheels (max-core, max-mojo-libs, mojo-compiler, mojo-compiler-mojo-libs). Installed self-contained under /opt/modular-max with an env-wired mojo-max launcher; GPU codegen and launch exist only in this prebuilt compiler, not in the open-source dev-lang/mojo build.

use.flag: Pull in the NVIDIA driver userland the runtime dlopens for CUDA devices
Pull in the HIP/ROCm userland the runtime dlopens for AMD devices
